data.raw_text:
Sa direktiba ni Chairman Atty. Don Artes, nagsagawa ang MMDA ng Site Selection Workshop para sa Feasibility Study ng Nature-Based Solutions (NbS) o paggamit natural na proseso upang tugunan ang mga hamon sa kapaligiran, baha, at climate change sa Metro Manila. 

Kasama ang mga LGU at eksperto mula sa Haskoning at Woodfields Consultants, layunin ng proyekto na balansehin ang grey infrastructure at natural na solusyon para sa mas epektibong flood management sa Metro Manila.

Sa pangunguna ng MMDA Solid Waste Management Office, Flood Control and Sewerage Management Office, at Planning Office, bahagi ang aktibidad ng Metro Manila Flood Management Project (MMFMP), na nagnanais na pagsamahin ang tradisyunal na "grey infrastructure" (tulad ng mga dike at pumping station) at makabagong Nature-Based Solutions. Sa pamamagitan  nito, mas magiging handa ang rehiyon sa baha gamit ang mga natural at sustainable na paraan.
#mmda #mmdaatyourservice

SB19: P-Pop Kings Redefining Global Style

Photo Credits: 1Z Entertainment + Billboard Philippines + Mega Magazine + ITM. + VMan Southeast Asia

Origins: Forged in Fire

SB19 in school uniforms with umbrellas on grassy lawn 

In 2016, five young talents—Pablo Nase (leader), Josh Cullen Santos, Justin de Dios, Ken Suson, and Stell Ajero—entered a grueling survival show inspired by South Korean training camps. They endured physical drills, vocal bootcamps, and personality shaping under ShowBT Philippines, debuting as SB19 on October 26, 2018, with the heartfelt ballad "Tilaluha."

The early days were rocky. P-pop was nascent in the Philippines, and their debut barely registered amid K-pop's dominance. Yet, persistence fueled their spark—by 2019, explosive single "Go Up" ignited a movement, winning Song of the Year at the MYX Music Awards.
SB19 channels effortless charm on MEGA Magazine's cover, blending schoolboy whimsy with high-fashion edge.

Check out our article @ https://t.co/1NetKI82Hw
